ReadingPaper 2.6.3

Maintenance release. Nothing changes in the app you read in. This one only makes a locally built copy look different from an installed one, so the two don't get mixed up while the app is being worked on.

ReadingPaper 2.6.1

Improved article parsing. Some newsletters carry sections the reader has to reconstruct client-side, and one arrangement wasn't being recognised — it came through as loose text and images. It now renders as intended.

ReadingPaper 2.6.0

Four themes, and they now colour the whole window. White, sepia, gray and black — the same set Instapaper offers on the web and on iOS — chosen from swatches painted in the theme they select.

  • Its own settings page. The theme is no longer buried in Reader settings: it's View ▸ Theme… (⌥⌘T), also on the reader toolbar and in the account menu.
  • The whole pane, not just the article. The strip behind the toolbar and the top and bottom of the article list used to stay white whatever you were reading in. Now the window is one continuous field of colour, with the list and the toolbar floating on top of it.
  • A contrasting article list. Each theme draws the list in the opposite tone — charcoal beside white paper, espresso beside sepia, off-white beside gray and black — so the two panes stay distinct instead of blending into one another.

Whatever you were reading in carries over: the old light and dark themes become white and black.

ReadingPaper 2.5.1

  • Redraw the app icon and move the accent to terracotta; 2.5.1

ReadingPaper 2.5.0

The app is now called ReadingPaper, with a new icon. It was "Reader for Instapaper"; the new name and artwork carry none of Instapaper's trademarks or trade dress. It's still the same unaffiliated client for the same account — you stay signed in, and your reader settings, folders and reading progress all carry over.

  • Installs from a disk image. Releases now ship as a .dmg with the usual drag-to-Applications window.
  • Updates itself. New versions are found, downloaded and installed in the background — no more copying builds between Macs. There's a ReadingPaper ▸ Check for Updates… menu item if you'd rather not wait.

This is the last version you'll have to install by hand.
